title: Nvidia backs Indian startup helping companies run AI models with fewer GPUs
script:
Nvidia just backed Simplismart, an AI infrastructure startup in Bengaluru helping companies run AI models using fewer GPUs.
Their software optimizes machine learning workloads so enterprises cut down on expensive hardware costs.
The annualized revenue run rate for Simplismart grew fourteen-fold in just six months.
More than half of that rapid revenue generation now comes directly from the United States.
Chief executive officer Amritanshu Jain leads the team building these enterprise deployment tools.
Would you trust Simplismart to cut your GPU bills?
